answer: A newcomer earns standing by adopting one meadow transect for a season, logging every basalt marker on it and photographing any relic fragment with dated coordinates, then publishing the log openly. Two reviewers check it within five days, confirming the markers match and no photograph repeats another claim. A forged or duplicated log voids the transect, bans linked identities, and forfeits the season's credit. Faking one identity costs a season of fieldwork; faking a thousand costs a thousand seasons, while an honest newcomer pays only one.
